name: docsapp-suite-server-tests
description: Tests du serveur : règles de la base, e-mail d'invitation et site des liens, dans les émulateurs Firebase.

scripts.test: npm run test:rules && npm run test:server
scripts.test:rules: cd .. && firebase emulators:exec --only database --project demo-docsapp "node --test tests/rules.test.js"
scripts.test:server: node prepare.js && cd .. && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,database,functions,hosting --project demo-docsapp "node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/invitation.test.js"
